newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds perk up. rapemeal seen as cheap.
newsitem.headline: European feeds perk up. rapemeal seen as cheap.

text.p: European meals and feeds closed with active trade in rapemeal on Wednesday as consumers perceived prices had slipped to bargain levels, traders said.
The morning kicked off with trades in sunmeal, prompted by a gap in arrivals into northwest European ports, but rapemeal took over in the afternoon as the focus of attention.
Morning trades were reported in afloat and summer delivery sunmeal, with traded prices rising through the day.
But in general the continued weather market in Chicago left many players sidelined, with consumers still on the look out for any sign rain in the U.S., which could cause prices to tumble.
Slipping prices for rapemeal caused sparked buyers into life in the afternoon, with positions from August through to October changing hands at steadily higher prices.
"Rapemeal prices have reached a level at 20/21 marks where they look very attractive," one trader said.

Others, pointing to the fact that Poland will be forced to import rapemeal following recent flood damage to its own rape crop, said they expected this extra demand to underpin the market in the months to come.
"People have obviously decided rapemeal is not going much lower," the trader said. --Amsterdam Newsroom +31 290 504 5000
